What I saw
- You asked to show an immediate press after losing possession from our progression shape.
- The team is in a 4-3-3 attacking shape in the middle third.

On the board
- Kept all 22 players frozen in their current positions.
- Added immediate counter-press pressure actions from the nearest blue shirts (#8 home-8-6 and #10 home-10-7) onto the red ball-carrier.
- Highlighted the defensive transition moment in the central channel.

Coaching points
- Nearest players apply an immediate organized counterpress for 3 to 5 seconds upon losing the ball.
- The goal of the counter-press is to win it back instantly or force a negative backward touch.
- If the ball is bypassed, the rest of the unit recovers compact distances quickly to deny central progression.
